descriptionChirho: A body of legal rules or regulations, often referring to the laws of a kingdom or of God, consistently translated across languages as law/ley/व्यवस्था/شريعة/법/sheria.
A specific authoritative command or proclamation issued by a ruler, translated as decree/decreto/आज्ञा/أمر/명령/amri rather than the general term for law.
A legal judgment or penalty imposed upon someone, translated with penalty/judgment vocabulary (sentencia/दंड/hukumu) distinct from both general law and royal decree.
